items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: It mentions Herb Pomeroy and of course it mentions your gig with Billie Holiday and Dakota Staton. / Yeah, Dakota Staton is wrong.

ctx.x: Well I am. So it’s interesting because I’ll just read a little bit of it. This is probably an update from his 1955 Leonard Feather original edition. And it says: “Chuck Israels, bass, born in New York City 1936, attended junior high in Cleveland, then to New York City where he went to the High School of Performing Arts, attended MIT, president of the Symphony Orchestra, self-taught on bass from 1955, studied music at Brandeis.” It mentions Herb Pomeroy and of course it mentions your gig with Billie Holiday and…
